title: TableRouter: Query-Aware Evidence Construction for Long-Table Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.32006v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs can reason over tables, but when tables outgrow the context budget, retrieving relevant rows is only part of the solution. A retrieved subset may omit information required for an exact aggregate; even complete evidence may remain difficult for an LLM to use. We introduce TableRouter, a training-free framework that analyzes each query, then chooses between two routes: a computation route, which derives question-conditioned statistics from the full table, and a coverage route, which retrieves relevant rows and column summaries. The chosen context is passed to a frozen LLM in one call. Across three LLMs and three large-table benchmarks, TableRouter outperforms the strongest of six single-call baselines in all nine settings by 1.2-18.3 accuracy points, using 77-95% fewer estimated FLOPs than truncated-table prompting, with indexing amortized across questions. The gains extend to long tables from databases not used in earlier experiments

translated_title: TableRouter：面向长表格问答的查询感知证据构建
translated_abstract: LLM能够对表格进行推理，但当表格规模超出上下文预算时，仅检索相关行并不足以解决问题。检索到的子集可能遗漏精确聚合所需的信息；即使证据完整，LLM也可能难以有效利用。我们提出了TableRouter，这是一个无需训练的框架，它分析每个查询，然后在两条路线之间做出选择：计算路线，从完整表格中推导以问题为条件的统计数据；覆盖路线，检索相关行和列摘要。所选上下文通过一次调用传递给冻结的LLM。在三个LLM和三个大表格基准测试中，TableRouter在全部九个设置中以1.2-18.3个准确率点的优势超越了六个单次调用基线中最强的一个，其估计FLOPs比截断表格提示方法减少77-95%，且索引成本可在多个问题间摊销。这些增益还可以扩展到来自此前实验未使用的数据库中的长表格。
tldr: TableRouter是一个无需训练的框架，通过分析查询在计算路线（从完整表格推导问题相关统计数据）和覆盖路线（检索相关行与列摘要）之间智能路由，在长表格问答任务中显著提升准确率（最高18.3个百分点）并将计算成本降低77-95%。
en_tdlr: TableRouter is a training-free framework that routes each query between a computation path (deriving question-conditioned statistics from the full table) and a coverage path (retrieving relevant rows and column summaries), improving long-table QA accuracy by up to 18.3 points while reducing computational costs by 77-95%.
